program_name: Diploma in English for Professional Communication

requirements.general_text: Any of these: SPM: Minimum 3Cs (including English). O-Level: Minimum 3Cs (including English). UEC: Minimum 3Bs (including English). Certificate / SKM III: Minimum CGPA of 2.00 with a C in English SPM. Other Qualifications: As recognized by the Senate of IUKL as equivalent to SPM Note: Students without a C in English SPM must take IELTS or its equivalent. ENGLISH LANGUAGE REQUIREMENT (INTERNATIONAL):  IELTS - 5 TOEFL (PBT) - 500 TOEFL (IBT) - 42 PTE - 47 MUET - BAND 3 Cambridge English - 154
